summary: Two hikers in their 20s excessively overdue arriving in Aspen on a day hike from Crested Butte via West Maroon Pass; reported 7pm July 13 amid deteriorating weather. MRA deployed drone + foot teams from the West Maroon Portal to the pass summit; Gunnison County SAR continued the search on 7/14. A citizen near Snowmass Lake contacted the hikers via satellite transmitter; MRA intercepted them on Buckskin Pass at ~3:07pm, tired but unhurt, and escorted them to the West Maroon Portal.
location: West Maroon Pass / Snowmass Lake / Buckskin Pass
notes: Multi-operational-period mission spanning 7/13-7/14; filed on report date 7/13.
